comment: Place at public/firmware/manifest.json. The key for each model MUST match the hw string the device reports in its BLE hello packet. The Build B / Everything-in-C firmware reports hw:"III.I". 'version' is compared against the device's reported fw with semantic ordering; 'file' is the path (relative to the web root) of the raw .bin image. Bump 'version' and replace the .bin to ship an update.
